errors.evidence: The description uses the plural noun 'категориите' (the categories) when it should be the singular 'категорията' (the category), as each sector represents a single category. This grammatical error is repeated for every category described.

errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от оранжевия и продължавайки по посока на часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the sectors are arranged in descending order by size in a clockwise direction. The values of the sectors, starting from the largest (orange, 36.4%) and moving clockwise, are 13.6% (red), 31.8% (purple), and 18.2% (green). This sequence is not in descending order.
